entities.summary: The Istanbul-class frigates are a group of ten multirole frigates currently being constructed for the Turkish Naval Forces and the Indonesian Navy. Developed under the MILGEM national warship program as the I-class frigate, the Istanbul class is an enlarged version of the Ada-class anti-submarine corvette, with enhanced endurance and MiDLAS vertical launching system (VLS) for multi-role capability.
